title: Saved Teleport
features:
🌌 Universal Waypoint Manager (Premium)
A fully universal, persistent, and animated waypoint system designed for any Roblox game. Stop losing your farming spots.
🔥 Key Features
✨ Premium UI & UX
Deep Midnight Theme: A clean, modern dark aesthetic (25, 25, 30 RGB) easy on the eyes.
Animated Borders: Features a rotating RGB Gradient Stroke that flows around the UI.
Dynamic Resizing: The window starts small and automatically grows as you add waypoints. No huge empty windows blocking your screen.
🖱️ Smooth Interaction
Smart Dragging: Uses TweenService for butter-smooth movement (no laggy dragging).
Pill Mode: Click the - button to shrink the UI into a tiny, movable "Waypoints" pill. Click it again to expand.
Sound Effects: Integrated audio for clicking, opening, and toggling features.
📍 Waypoint Logic
Universal Persistence: Automatically creates a unique Save File for every game you play (PlaceId).
Auto-Save/Load: Waypoints are saved instantly and reload automatically when you rejoin the server.
Unlimited Slots: Add as many spots as you need; the list scrolls automatically.
⚡ AFK & Farming Tools
Loop Teleport: Click "LOOP" to lock your character to a specific waypoint.
Anti-Fall: Automatically resets your velocity to 0 every tick while looping, preventing fall damage or glitching out of the map.
Instant TP: One-click teleportation to any saved spot.
📜 How to Use
Type a name in the box and click Create.
Drag the header to move the UI.
Click - to minimize if it's in the way.
Click LOOP on a waypoint to AFK farm that spot.
